semiconductor_relevance: High — AI Technology, Inc. specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging materials, which are critical for the performance and reliability of microelectronic devices.
summary: AI Technology, Inc. is a leader in developing advanced semiconductor and microelectronic packaging materials, focusing on high reliability film and paste adhesives. Their innovative solutions include a range of conductive and insulating adhesives, as well as temporary bonding adhesives for wafer processing, catering to the needs of the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.United States: The company is based in Princeton, NJ, USA, indicating a strong presence in the North American semiconductor market.
